# 100.00 of the US dollars usd_owed_on_a_card_that_paid_a_bill.txt owes on the
# card, repaid from the Canadian dollar bank for 138.00 CAD on 2026-09-01, the
# cost basis it repaid not chosen yet.
#
# The only US dollar cost basis the book keeps is BILL-USD-1's, so the
# repayment is a disposal on the owed side pending that choice: the book counts
# 100.00 USD pending against the dollars that cost basis stands for, until an
# edit states the cost basis.
#
# Verified by
# tests/scenario/test_pending_counts_the_cost_basis_an_invoice_or_a_bill_opened.py.
2026-09-01 * "Card part paid back"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	Liabilities:Credit Card USD 100.00 USD
		cost_basis_split_guid: $pending$
	Assets:Chequing -138.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		value: "-100.00"
